# Department of Environmental & Occupational Health Sciences (DEOHS)

> DEOHS at the University of Washington School of Public Health advances environmental and occupational health through education, research, and service to Washington State and the Pacific Northwest.

DEOHS is a leading academic department focused on protecting public health through research and education in environmental health, occupational safety, and workplace health. The department operates specialized research centers and clinics while offering undergraduate and graduate degree programs.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Health
- Occupational Health
- Workplace Safety
- Environmental Public Health
- Research Centers
- Clean Air
- Clean Water
- Safe Food
- Sustainable Communities
- Diversity & Equity
- University of Washington
- School of Public Health
- Pacific Northwest
- Washington State
- Field Research and Consultation
